props.title: Step inside the Abyss
props.body: Constructed as a meditative chamber 4,000 metres below the surface: soft-body flora and glowing spores that answer your presence. Drag to turn it, scroll to come closer.

props.title: Rings in zero gravity
props.body: Brushed-titanium rings hung around a dark mineral core and lit by blue planetary bounce light. Monumental stillness, made to be turned.

props.title: A liquid metal horizon
props.body: Gerstner waves and Fresnel reflections turn tidal data into a living metallic sea that shifts weight with every gesture.

props.title: Sound you can see
props.body: Harmonic frequencies drawn as suspended waves and concentric rings. Move through them and the field answers.
